summary: The driver runs a gate-review session (/vloop:gate-review, fence/gate-review.json, model.gate-review and effort.gate-review) after the base run of the gates; its gate-verdict/v1 verdict is kept as reports/gate-review-<round>.json. A failed first round sends the problems back to the plan session, a second failure saves the plan blocked and ends the run with exit 2, and a resume repeats only the base run.
verified: vloop task gate T10 exited 0 and printed GATE OK.
notes: acceptPlan now returns (plan, *Halt, error): each round is baseGates then, if clean, stampPlan (saved running, since the review session runs vloop task gate) then gateReviewRound; acceptance problems and review findings share the planRounds budget and go back through plan-problems.md. Rounds is the round the review ran in. A plan failed twice is saved blocked with gate_review {2, FAIL}, committed by Plan() as the plan commit, and the halt (exit 2) is returned after it. A missing or invalid verdict is a FAIL; the driver writes a synthetic FAIL gate-verdict as the report so the path in the exit line exists. Resume: Iterator.Run sees gate_review.verdict FAIL, runs baseGates only (resumeBaseGates), and on success sets the verdict to PASS (the operator's amendment is the ruling) so later resumes do not repeat it; if a gate still passes on the base it halts exit 2. Only gate-review session records are session/v2 (iteration 0, no task); work, review and plan stay session/v1 until T11. Prompt() drops the trailing space when arg is empty. Existing run tests' session counts rose by one for the gate review session; the cmd/vloop stub answers /vloop:gate-review with a passing verdict before the per-test script runs. The /vloop:gate-review skill text is T12's. go test of internal/defect and internal/cli needs the VLOOP_* env unset inside a session.
